app_id.title: App ID
app_id.description: The app whose new or updated items are polled (POST /item/app/{app_id}/filter/, newest edit first). Used when no item_id is given; the message's value is used first, then the step configuration's app_id or appId.

item_id.title: Item ID
item_id.description: The ID of the item to poll (GET /item/{item_id}); the item is returned when it changed since the last poll. When given, it is polled instead of the app.

limit.title: Limit
limit.description: How many of the app's most recently edited items each poll reads (default 30, at most 500).
